answer_1.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed the way we produce and consume written communication, driving remarkable advancements in text generation across a wide array of domains.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates essays on two prompts: banning smoking in restaurants and the importance of part-time jobs, using 12 modern LLMs across diverse author personas.
